authorization.next_if_fail: Diagnose strict-alias recall/coverage by frozen alias class before changing any alias policy. Do not use return/outcome information.
authorization.next_if_pass: Design and authorize checkpointed full 2021-2025 direct-GDELT attention extraction.

matching.rule: For every GKG ORGANIZATIONS token, construct both the frozen full normalized form and conservative legal-core normalized form. A production alias matches only by exact equality to one of those two deterministic representations. Count a GKG row at most once per alias.

metric.daily_matched_source_document_weight: sum(NUMARTS) for rows whose ORGANIZATIONS set exactly matches the active production alias
metric.daily_total_source_document_weight: sum(NUMARTS) over successfully parsed GKG rows
metric.note: NUMARTS is used as the GKG source-document weight, consistent with the prior direct-GDELT pilot. Zero strict matches are observations, not source-file missingness.

sample.reason: Reuse the five previously frozen representative 7-day windows, now against the complete PIT alias universe. This tests all active aliases while avoiding premature full-history extraction.
